recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a bounded completion of the already-approved R5/Persuasive clarification; no additional FHIR-core work is indicated for FHIR-31425 unless a future work-group decision changes broader NDJSON guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-31425 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification request for the NDJSON representation page. It asked to reference the NDJSON specification, consistently use the name "NDJSON" instead of "ND-JSON", "nd-json", or "ns-json", make the single-resource-type sentence a SHALL requirement, and label the sample "NDJSON example".
initial_application: The historical Jira-tagged commit 5ff951a848f4c4e937ebbcd51442e9262f65ab7a applied the main page change in source/nd-json.html, including the external spec link and SHALL wording, but changed only that file. The current source still had an "Example" caption instead of "NDJSON example", a double space in "SHALL  only", a misleading sentence saying NDJSON was a variant of the NDJSON format, and several current navigation/format-summary labels using non-preferred names.
additional_context: Confluence FHIR-I minutes from 2021-05-31 list FHIR-31425 as persuasive, matching the Jira disposition. The documentation module is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/hierarchy.xml plus the related source/*.html pages feed current built navigation, downloads, history, and resource-format documentation. Jira and Zulip searches did not reveal a later core decision that reversed or narrowed the requested wording cleanup.
reconciliation: Published a non-empty source commit on the combined branch. The commit corrects source/nd-json.html to describe NDJSON as a JSON variant, label the sample "NDJSON example", and say each NDJSON document SHALL only contain resources of a single type. It also normalizes current user-visible labels in source/documentation.html, source/downloads.html, source/hierarchy.xml, source/resource-formats.html, and source/history.html to NDJSON.
source_changes: source/nd-json.html: corrected the opening description to say NDJSON is a JSON variant, changed the example label to "NDJSON example", and normalized the SHALL sentence spacing.
source/documentation.html, source/downloads.html, source/hierarchy.xml, source/resource-formats.html, source/history.html: normalized current user-visible format labels to NDJSON.
